1→import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
     2→import { apiFetch } from '@/lib/api-client'
     3→import type { ProjectUpdate } from '@/types/fastapi'
     4→
     5→// =============================================================================
     6→// Type Mappings
     7→// =============================================================================
     8→
     9→const STATUS_TO_FASTAPI: Record<string, string> = {
    10→  'new': 'Проектирование',
    11→  'processing': 'Закупки',
    12→  'paid': 'Оплачено',
    13→  'delivered': 'Доставлено',
    14→  'cancelled': 'Отменен',
    15→  'requested': 'Закупки',
    16→  'invoiced': 'На оплате',
    17→  'completed': 'Завершен',
    18→}
    19→
    20→const VALID_TRANSITIONS: Record<string, string[]> = {
    21→  'new': ['processing', 'cancelled'],
    22→  'processing': ['requested', 'cancelled'],
    23→  'requested': ['invoiced', 'processing', 'cancelled'],
    24→  'invoiced': ['paid', 'requested', 'cancelled'],
    25→  'paid': ['delivered', 'invoiced'],
    26→  'delivered': ['completed', 'paid'],
    27→  'completed': [],
    28→  'cancelled': [],
    29→}
    30→
    31→const MANDATORY_COMMENT_TRANSITIONS = ['cancelled']
    32→
    33→// =============================================================================
    34→// Helper Functions
    35→// =============================================================================
    36→
    37→function getRussianStatus(englishStatus: string): string {
    38→  return STATUS_TO_FASTAPI[englishStatus] || englishStatus
    39→}
    40→
    41→// =============================================================================
    42→// POST /api/projects/[id]/status - Update project status
    43→// =============================================================================
    44→
    45→export async function POST(
    46→  request: NextRequest,
    47→  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
    48→) {
    49→  try {
    50→    const { id } = await params
    51→    const body = await request.json()
    52→    const { status, comment, changedAt } = body
    53→
    54→    if (!status) {
    55→      return NextResponse.json(
    56→        { error: 'Не указан новый статус' },
    57→        { status: 400 }
    58→      )
    59→    }
    60→
    61→    // First, fetch the current project to validate transition
    62→    const currentResult = await apiFetch(`/api/projects/${id}`)
    63→
    64→    if (currentResult.error) {
    65→      const statusCode = (currentResult.error.details as any)?.status || 500
    66→      if (statusCode === 404) {
    67→        return NextResponse.json(
    68→          { error: 'Проект не найден' },
    69→          { status: 404 }
    70→        )
    71→      }
    72→      return NextResponse.json(
    73→        { error: currentResult.error.error, details: currentResult.error.details },
    74→        { status: statusCode }
    75→      )
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    const currentProject: any = currentResult.data
    79→    const currentStatus = currentProject.status
    80→
    81→    // Validate transition (using English status codes)
    82→    const allowedTransitions = VALID_TRANSITIONS[currentStatus as keyof typeof VALID_TRANSITIONS] || []
    83→    if (!allowedTransitions.includes(status)) {
    84→      return NextResponse.json(
    85→        {
    86→          error: `Недопустимый переход статуса: ${currentStatus} → ${status}`,
    87→          allowedTransitions,
    88→        },
    89→        { status: 400 }
    90→      )
    91→    }
    92→
    93→    // Validate mandatory comment
    94→    if (MANDATORY_COMMENT_TRANSITIONS.includes(status) && !comment?.trim()) {
    95→      return NextResponse.json(
    96→        { error: 'Для данного перехода необходимо указать причину' },
    97→        { status: 400 }
    98→      )
    99→    }
   100→
   101→    // Update project status via FastAPI
   102→    const updateData: ProjectUpdate = {
   103→      status: getRussianStatus(status),
   104→    }
   105→
   106→    const result = await apiFetch(`/api/projects/${id}`, {
   107→      method: 'PUT',
   108→      body: updateData,
   109→    })
   110→
   111→    if (result.error) {
   112→      const statusCode = (result.error.details as any)?.status || 500
   113→      return NextResponse.json(
   114→        { error: result.error.error, details: result.error.details },
   115→        { status: statusCode }
   116→      )
   117→    }
   118→
   119→    return NextResponse.json({
   120→      success: true,
   121→      fromStatus: currentStatus,
   122→      toStatus: status,
   123→      message: `Статус проекта изменен: ${currentStatus} → ${status}`,
   124→    })
   125→  } catch (error) {
   126→    console.error('Status change error:', error)
   127→    return NextResponse.json(
   128→      { error: 'Ошибка изменения статуса' },
   129→      { status: 500 }
   130→    )
   131→  }
   132→}
